_comment: Hand-researched dating records keyed by song_name (web research, 2026-09-30). Songs not listed here fall back to the default in build.py. Keys: t=song_type, op=origin_period, ey=earliest_attestation_year, src=attestation_source, ca=composer_or_adapter, cy=composition_or_adaptation_year, urls, c=confidence, n=notes.

康定情歌.src: 吴文季 transcribed 《跑马溜溜的山上》 in Kangding area 1946; arranged by 江定仙, premiered by 喻宜萱 Nanjing 19 Apr 1947; 大中华唱片 recording 1948
康定情歌.ca: 吴文季 (transcription); 江定仙 (piano arrangement)
康定情歌.n: Base tune is a Kangding 溜溜调. Conflicting authorship claim: 宣汉 researchers (欧阳鹤龄, from 2004) attribute words/music to 李依若 (1911-1959), supposedly written 1932 as 《跑马山》; this is disputed and not independently documented, so earliest attestation kept at 1946. Some sources (Baike) call it 1940s-created.

小河淌水.src: published in 《教学唱》 1947 no.2 (signed 赵华) among 弥渡 songs collected by 尹宜公
小河淌水.ca: 尹宜公 (from 弥渡 《放羊调》/山歌)
小河淌水.n: Borderline newly-composed: 尹宜公 is credited with words and reworked melody (1947) based on 弥渡 放羊调. Copyright dispute 1994-2007: 高梁 claimed to have written the melody in 1943; Yunnan Copyright Bureau revoked then National Copyright Bureau reinstated 尹宜公's registration. 黄虹 performed it from 1953. 弥渡民歌 national ICH 2011.

太阳出来喜洋洋.src: Sogou/Baidu Baike: written 1942 by 金鼓 (first work), popularised in 1950s via 蔡绍序
太阳出来喜洋洋.n: Conflict: other sources credit 蓝河 with creating it from 石柱土家啰儿调. Uses 石柱 啰儿调 vocables (啰儿、朗朗扯光扯). 石柱土家啰儿调 = national ICH 2006 (genre context). This row is the 蔡绍序 concert version.

太阳出来喜洋洋（石柱啰儿调）.n: Tradition-bearer (杨中合) rendering of 石柱土家啰儿调, the source idiom of the 1942/1950s concert song. 啰儿调 national ICH 2006. No song-specific date found; relation 'source form' is per dataset note - sources say the concert song drew on 啰儿调, not necessarily on this exact tune.

槐花几时开.src: lyrics recorded in Guangxu-period printed 《四川山歌》; tune from 宜宾 神歌; adapted by 余祖荣, arranged 李树莲, published in 《西南民歌》 (西南军区战斗文工团) 1950; 丁善德 piano setting 1951
槐花几时开.n: Attestation range = Guangxu reign (1875-1908); exact year of the print not found. The Qing attestation is for the text; the 宜宾 tune is attested from 1950. Recording by 蔡绍序.

黄杨扁担.src: collected Feb 1957 in 秀山 白粉墙村 from 花灯 master 严思和; notated by 林祖炎, 金干; published 1958 《四川花灯歌曲》
黄杨扁担.n: 秀山 花灯 song (now Chongqing). Origin disputed between 秀山 and 酉阳; 2002 press investigation favoured 秀山. Lyric '下柳州' altered to '下酉州' in 1980 publication.

螃蟹歌.n: 川东/宜宾 folk song with many regional variants (Yunnan, Hunan). One web source says the 宜宾 version has ~70 years of history - vague, not used as a date.

大河涨水沙浪沙.src: local sources: widely sung in 呈贡 before the end of Qing (昆明调/呈贡小调)
大河涨水沙浪沙.n: Pre-Qing-end popularity is a secondary claim without a cited primary document. Popularised nationally by 黄虹 in 1950s; 127 local variants of 大河涨水 collected in 玉溪. This recording: 刘淑芳.

川江号子.n: Genre-level (work chant family, not a single song). Genre context: national ICH 2006; claims of '3000 years' are genre antiquity rhetoric, not evidence for this chant.

柳街薅秧歌.n: Genre/local tradition: 薅秧歌（柳街薅秧歌）, 都江堰市, Sichuan provincial ICH (4th batch); no song-level date.

猜调.src: 黄虹 performed it at the 1st National Folk Music & Dance Festival, Beijing, April 1953
猜调.n: 昆明 官渡 children's/riddle 小调; some sources label it Yi (彝族). Yunnan provincial ICH 2006. Source claim that Ming-era Han migration shaped these tunes is general context, not a date.

耍山调.src: 黄虹 live recording as 《昆明小调》(耍山调) at 1953 national festival

赶马调.src: sung by 黄虹 at the April 1953 national festival
赶马调.n: 宾川/祥云 caravan (马帮) song; related 宾川 long narrative 赶马调 recorded in multiple local versions. 'Thousand-year caravan history' framing is genre context, not a song date.

放马山歌.src: collected by 黄虹 in the early 1950s
放马山歌.n: Western Yunnan (玉溪 attribution also seen). Only 'early 1950s' given, no exact year.

弥渡山歌.src: collected/arranged by 袁留安 and sung by 黄虹 (1950s)
弥渡山歌.n: A 1950 《中国民歌》 volume included 6 弥渡 songs, but it is not confirmed that this song was among them. Genre: 弥渡民歌 national ICH 2011; 嘉庆-era 《滇系》 '山歌九章' cited for antiquity of 弥渡 singing (genre context).

绣荷包.n: 弥渡 花灯 小调. A 《绣荷包》 lyric appears in 《白雪遗音》 (1828) - this is the pan-Chinese 绣荷包 lyric family, not evidence for this 弥渡 tune, so not used as the date.

月牙弯弯映小河.n: Described as a 大姚 (Yunnan) folk song; 黄虹 recorded it in the late 1970s.

高山砍柴.src: 黄虹 recording with Yunnan Song & Dance Ensemble, dated 1963 in online reissue
高山砍柴.n: Year comes from an online upload description only.

南坪小调.n: Genre context: 南坪曲子 (九寨沟) said to begin mid-Qing after 雍正-era 陕甘 migration, consolidated late Qing/early Republic; national ICH 2008. Genre date only.

采花.op: before the Red Army period (re-texted as 《盼红军》)
采花.src: 南坪 小调; new words 《盼红军》 set to it during the revolutionary war period
采花.n: 彭丽媛 performance (album 1984) adapts the 南坪 tune. Existence before the 1930s is inferred from the 盼红军 contrafact; exact year not documented.

冬寒菜.n: Probably 泸县 《一窝冬寒菜》; a local news claim says it originated in Southern Song (~800 yrs) - unsupported, treat as legend/local lore.

情姐下河洗衣裳.src: found 1979 by 石阡 county cultural centre (聂孝光, 蔡正国) from 仡佬族 singer 毛承翔
情姐下河洗衣裳.n: Sources identify it as a 石阡 仡佬族 song (index says 汉族). Lyrics reference the 夜郎竹王 myth (legend, not evidence of age). Popularised by 穆维平, national youth singer contest 2003.

达坂城的姑娘.src: 王洛宾 notated it in Lanzhou 1938 from a Uyghur driver's song; first Uyghur song set to Chinese words
达坂城的姑娘.n: Originally titled 《马车夫之歌》; Uyghur source song reported as 《康巴尔罕》.

掀起你的盖头来.src: based on 《亚里亚》 collected by 王洛宾 in 酒泉 1939; staged 1940 for 青海儿童抗战剧团
掀起你的盖头来.n: Part of 王洛宾 authorship/copyright controversy.

半个月亮爬上来.src: 王洛宾 1939 adaptation of Uyghur dance song 《依拉拉，沙依格》 (Kashgar)

青春舞曲.src: 王洛宾 obtained the tune from Uyghur traders in 酒泉 (1938 per one source, 1939 per others) and set Chinese words 1939
青春舞曲.n: Sources conflict on collection year (1938 vs 1939); earliest given.

阿拉木汗.src: recorded by 王洛宾 1939, adapted early 1944

玛依拉.src: Kazakh song notated by 王洛宾 in the late 1930s (Qinghai); third verse rewritten after 1949 with 柯仁·柯克太; published 1959
玛依拉.n: 王洛宾 later changed credits from 'recorded' to 'composed' for such songs - contested authorship. Recording: 殷秀梅.

燕子.src: melody re-set 1944 in Almaty by Akhmet Zhubanov (朱巴诺夫) from a Kazakh folk tune for the opera 《阿拜》; Chinese version by 吴祖强 1954
燕子.n: Often wrongly attributed to 王洛宾. Soviet Kazakh origin - cross-border borrowing rather than local Xinjiang folk song.

牡丹汗.n: 伊犁 Uyghur song. Some web sources say 王洛宾 collected it in 伊犁 in 1940, but 王洛宾 only entered Xinjiang in 1949 per other sources; unverified, not used.

马车夫之歌.n: Rhymoi 听见新疆 Uyghur recording. Same title as 王洛宾's 1938 original title for 达坂城的姑娘 (source song 康巴尔罕), but identity of tune not verified.

伊犁的大路边.n: 伊犁 Uyghur folk song (Rhymoi 听见新疆); Chinese lyric version credited to 伊力帕尼·亚生.

嘎克库（白天鹅在歌唱）.src: Kazakh song 《Гәкку》 by folk composer-singer Үкілі Ыбырай
嘎克库（白天鹅在歌唱）.n: Identification of the Rhymoi track with Ukili Ybyray's Gakku is by title; composer lifespan from general knowledge/egemen profile. Authored folk song transmitted orally - classed traditional.

阿合巴彦.n: Possibly Kazakh 《Ақбаян》: one Kazakh source credits Бексұлтан Байкенжеев, another database lists it as 'халық әні' (folk). Identity and authorship unresolved.

十二木卡姆（选段）.n: Genre context only: Uyghur Muqam proclaimed UNESCO masterpiece 25 Nov 2005; 16th-c. codification claims are genre-level. Excerpt not identified.

伊拉克木卡姆（选段）.n: Iraq muqam of the Twelve Muqam; genre context UNESCO 2005. No song-level date.

刀郎木卡姆.n: Dolan muqam (麦盖提/巴楚/阿瓦提); part of Uyghur Muqam UNESCO 2005. Genre-level only.

哈密木卡姆.n: Hami muqam; part of Uyghur Muqam UNESCO 2005. Genre-level only.

Mitiz Meshrep（麦西来甫）.n: Meshrep: UNESCO Urgent Safeguarding List 2010 (genre context).

北京的金山上.src: 马倬 reworked 《山南古酒歌》 (learned from folk artist 扎西) 1960-64; premiered by 雍西 at national minority amateur festival, Beijing 1964; 2nd verse added 1972 for 才旦卓玛
北京的金山上.n: Traditional tune (山南古酒歌) with new political lyrics; Baike dates the adaptation 1961, other accounts 1960-1964. ey=1964 is the first public performance of this song; the source tune is undated.

吉白尼玛（东山顶上）.n: 囊玛 piece. The 'East Mountain' text is conventionally attributed to the 6th Dalai Lama 仓央嘉措 (1683-1706), which would date the lyric not the tune; link to this 囊玛 not verified. Distinct from the film song 《在那东山顶上》 (张千一, 《益西卓玛》).

阿玛勒火.n: Standard 囊玛 repertoire (Lhasa). Genre context: 囊玛 associated with Potala 囊玛岗 performances; no song-level date.

夏仓郭仓.n: 堆谐 genre. Legend (not evidence): 拉孜堆谐 said to originate in the Sakya period (~700 yrs). 拉孜堆谐 national ICH 2008.

央金朵朵.n: 堆谐 genre; Sakya-period origin of 堆谐 is legend. No song-level date.

康巴酒歌.n: Kham drinking song; performer/context unverified in dataset, could be modern.

羌谐（Changshay 酒歌）.n: Dataset note: only plausibly traditional item among many modern results; not verified.

嘎达梅林.src: narrative song arose shortly after 嘎达梅林's uprising (Nov 1929) and death (9 Apr 1931), first as short lyrical songs, later a long narrative
嘎达梅林.n: 科尔沁 narrative folk song, national ICH (科左中旗). Terminus post quem 1929-1931 from historical event; recording by 阿木古楞 (CCTV).

诺恩吉雅.op: late Qing (19th c.; exact year unknown)
诺恩吉雅.src: Baike: arose at end of Qing, prototype traceable to mid-19th c.; heroine was niece of the 11th 奈曼 prince
诺恩吉雅.n: 奈曼旗 老哈河; 科尔沁民歌 national ICH 2008. Sources differ between 'late Qing' and 'mid-19th c.'.

森吉德玛.src: 贺绿汀 orchestral piece 《森吉德玛》 based on the song, 1945
森吉德玛.n: 鄂尔多斯 短调. Origin story (young man writing verses on inn walls) is legend. ey is a terminus ante quem from the 贺绿汀 arrangement.

鸿雁.src: Chinese song: lyrics 吕燕卫 for TV series 《东归英雄》 (额尔古纳乐队 arr.), popular 2005; melody from 乌拉特 toast song 《鸿嘎鲁》 attributed to the 3rd Mergen Gegen 罗布生丹毕佳拉森 (d. 1766)
鸿雁.ca: 吕燕卫 (lyrics); melody attr. 罗布生丹毕佳拉森 (Mergen Gegen)
鸿雁.n: Baike dates the 额尔古纳 recording 2006; others 2005. c.1750 composition of 鸿嘎鲁 is 'possibly' in a secondary source; translation 'white swan' -> '鸿雁' from the 1950s.

牧歌.src: 瞿希贤 1954 a cappella choral arrangement of 呼伦贝尔/新巴尔虎 long song with Chinese lyrics (海默 per one source; title card of one recording credits 安波)
牧歌.ca: 瞿希贤 (arr.); 海默 or 安波 (Chinese lyrics)
牧歌.n: Rows mix long-song renditions (阿木古楞/特仑, 乌英嘎) and the 瞿希贤 choral version. Lyricist credit conflicts (海默 vs 安波). Underlying folk long song undated.

辽阔的草原.src: 宝音德力格尔 sang it at the 5th World Festival of Youth (Warsaw) 1955, winning gold
辽阔的草原.n: 巴尔虎 long song. Genre: Mongolian long song UNESCO 2005 (shared China/Mongolia).

黑骏马.n: 《钢嘎·哈拉》, 乌珠穆沁 (锡林郭勒) / Sükhbaatar long song, cross-border. No song-level date.

小黄马.n: 锡林郭勒 long song associated with 哈扎布. No song-level date.

圣主成吉思汗.n: 鄂尔多斯 praise song. Genre context: 古如歌 songs like 《圣主的两匹骏马》 claimed to date from Yuan - genre claim, not evidence for this song.

赞颂成吉思汗.n: Praise song/long song; 古如歌 Yuan-era claims are genre-level.

六十棵榆树.n: Web sources call it an 鄂尔多斯 long song (index labels 短调). No song-level date.

扎恩达勒.n: Daur mountain-song genre; 达斡尔族民歌（扎恩达勒） national ICH 2nd batch (2008). Genre-level, song unidentified.

赞达仁.n: Oroqen mountain-song genre; listed in 2nd national ICH batch (2008) (one source says 2006 - conflict). Genre-level.

毛敖吉坎河.n: 敖鲁古雅 Evenki festival/bonfire song, lyrics improvised to situation. No song-level date.

正月儿玛.n: 科尔沁 narrative song. Genre context: most 科尔沁/奈曼 narrative songs arose late Qing - early Republic (genre claim).

Urtiin Duu.n: Generic 'long song' label, specific song unidentified (Mongolia side).

Mongol Nutgiin Uzesgelen.n: Mongolia-side item; title could be a modern composed song or a long-song group; not verified.

好花红.src: heard by 罗宗贤 and Guizhou Song & Dance troupe in 惠水 1953; notated by 曹玉凤 1955; performed at 2nd national folk festival 1957 (CNR recording)
好花红.n: 惠水 Bouyei; the published melody underwent 'collective preliminary modification' in 1955.

阿诗玛叙事长诗（第一段）.src: Chinese compiled text (黄铁, 杨知勇, 刘绮, 公刘; 1953) published 《云南日报》 30 Jan 1954
阿诗玛叙事长诗（第一段）.n: Sani oral epic; national ICH 2006. 1954 is the first widely circulated Chinese text; earlier fieldwork transcriptions may exist. The sung melody is not dated.

打歌·海菜腔.n: Genre context: 石屏 海菜腔 described in a Daoguang-era (1821-1850) poem; national ICH 2006. Genre-level date, not this performance's song.

哈尼族多声部民歌.n: Genre: documented by 吴志明 in the 1986 folk-song anthology survey (红河 阿扎河 普春); national ICH 2006.

梅葛·相遇调.n: 姚安 马游坪 梅葛; systematically collected from the 1950s; national ICH 2008. Genre-level.

日夜相守（长嘹）.n: 平果 嘹歌; genre texts fixed in Ming-era 古壮字 manuscripts per sources; 晋《交州记》 '辽辽之歌' often cited (genre antiquity). National ICH 2008.

那坡山歌.n: Black-clad Zhuang (黑衣壮); 那坡壮族民歌 national ICH 2006. Genre-level.

Ayshemgul Memet 维吾尔传统民歌.n: Performer-named live set (641 s, may contain several songs); specific song(s) unidentified.

Kerim Aiday（克里木阿依达）.n: CGTN VR clip; song not identified in sources, may include narration.
